front_question: What is a neuron? Label its structural components and trace the pathway of an electrical nerve impulse.
back_answer: A neuron is the functional structural unit of the nervous system. Structure: Dendrite, Cell Body (Cyton), Axon, Nerve Ending. Impulse Pathway: Receptor acquires stimulus -> Dendrite tip generates electrical impulse -> Cell body -> Axon -> Axon terminal releases neurotransmitters across Synapse -> Dendrite of next neuron.

front_question: Name four key phytohormones and their physiological roles in plants.
back_answer: 1. Auxin: Promotes cell elongation and phototropic shoot growth. 2. Gibberellins: Promotes stem growth and seed germination. 3. Cytokinins: Stimulates rapid cell division in fruits and seeds. 4. Abscisic Acid (ABA): Plant growth inhibitor, promotes leaf wilting and stomatal closure.

front_question: What is a reflex arc? Trace the pathway of a spinal reflex when touching a hot object.
back_answer: A reflex arc is the neural pathway that executes automatic, rapid, involuntary responses to stimuli bypassing conscious brain thinking. Pathway: Heat Receptor in skin -> Sensory Neuron -> Spinal Cord (Relay Neuron) -> Motor Neuron -> Effector Muscle (contracts hand away).

front_question: Describe an experimental demonstration of phototropism in plant shoots (Activity 6.2).
back_answer: Setup: Place a potted plant inside a dark box with a single side window admitting light. Observation: Shoot bends towards the side window source of light. Mechanism: Auxin hormone synthesized at shoot tip diffuses to the shaded side, stimulating faster cell elongation on the dark side, curving the shoot tip towards light.

front_question: List four major human endocrine glands, their hormones, primary functions, and deficiency disorders.
back_answer: 1. Thyroid: Secretes Thyroxin (regulates carbohydrate/fat metabolism); deficiency causes Goitre (swollen neck, iodine shortage). 2. Pancreas: Secretes Insulin (lowers blood glucose); deficiency causes Diabetes mellitus. 3. Pituitary: Secretes Growth Hormone (stimulates organ growth); deficiency causes Dwarfism / excess causes Gigantism. 4. Adrenal: Secretes Adrenaline ('fight or flight' emergency response, increases heartbeat and breathing rate).
